# Vendored front-end libraries

Served from here instead of a CDN so the web viewer works on a LAN with no internet access. Each file is the unmodified upstream build from npm, except that the trailing `sourceMappingURL` comment is removed because the source maps aren't vendored.

The versions are pinned in `scripts/web-vendor/package.json` and its lockfile, and `scripts/web-vendor/sync.mjs` lists which files each package contributes. Don't edit these files by hand: CI re-runs the sync and fails if anything here differs from it.

## Upgrading

Dependabot opens a pull request when a package has a security advisory, and a grouped one each month for other releases. A workflow on its pull requests re-runs the sync and pushes the updated files, so the diff shows exactly what changed. Check the pages that use the library before merging: Bootstrap and Font Awesome are on every page, Chart.js on the dashboard, Contacts and Multibyte, Socket.IO on every live page, the map and graph libraries on Mesh, and js-sha256 on Real-time.

To upgrade by hand, change the version in `scripts/web-vendor/package.json`, then run `npm install --package-lock-only --ignore-scripts && npm run vendor` in that directory. If a package moves or renames a file, update its entry in `sync.mjs`.

## The packet decoder

`../js/meshcore-browser.mjs` is a browser bundle of `@michaelhart/meshcore-decoder` 0.4.0 (MIT) with its crypto-js and @noble/ed25519 dependencies, built by `scripts/meshcore-decoder-browser/build.sh` from commit `60733c0` of the agessaman/meshcore-decoder fork (0.4.0 isn't on npm) plus the browser entry in that directory. Dependabot doesn't track it. To upgrade, run the script with the new commit, update the pinned default in it, and check the Real-time byte breakdown on a multibyte packet.
